family.description: This domain is found in a group of fungal proteins, including Chitin synthase 4 from Gibberella zeae (CHS4), which plays a role in the polymerisation of chitin [[cite:PUB00155063],[cite:PUB00155061]]. This domain is predicted to adopt a globular structure with similarity to Cytochrome b5-like heme/steroid binding domain ([pfam:PF00173]). Despite this global similarity this domain lacks haem coordinating residues and is probably not involved in haem binding.
family.name: Chitin synthase 4-like domain
